## 简体中文

- 修复 Word 导出时日期、数值范围里的波浪号误把正文变成下标的问题。普通文字中的 `^` 也按原文保留，例如 `x^2+y^2`。
- 编辑器、Word 预览和导出支持 `H[2]{.sub}O`、`m[2]{.sup}`。上下标可与颜色和下划线组合，普通文字沿用所在位置的颜色，显式填写 `color` 才改色。
- 保留公式及 `<sub>`、`<sup>` 的上下标写法。旧的 `~文字~`、`^文字^` 按普通文字导出。可用反引号或转义开头的方括号展示属性语法源码。

## English

- Fix Word exports treating text between range tildes as subscript. Preserve literal carets in plain text such as `x^2+y^2`.
- Use `H[2]{.sub}O` and `m[2]{.sup}` in the editor, Word preview, and DOCX export. Combine either attribute with color and underlining. Text inherits its surrounding color unless an explicit `color` is set.
- Continue using math or the `<sub>` and `<sup>` tags for explicit scripts. The legacy `~text~` and `^text^` forms export as literal text. Use backticks or escape the opening bracket to show attribute syntax as source.
